metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Rosetta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Rosetta branch of the Nile Delta (approximately 31.2°N, 30.4°E) - Dates: 1984 (Landsat 5 TM) vs. 2021 (Landsat 8/9 or Sentinel-2) - Collection: Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8 for 2021 - Metric: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) to measure vegetation cover 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud/shadow masking using QA bands - Ensure valid pixels remain after masking - Focus on the delta region (smaller buffer around Rosetta mouth) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check collection size for each year (C1 if empty) - Check pixel count after masking (C2 if zero valid pixels) - Check if NDVI values are in valid range [-1, 1] (C3 if invalid) - Compare mean NDVI: 1984 > 2021 → A, otherwise → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Rosetta branch of Nile Delta (31.2°N, 30.4°E) const geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([30.4, 31.2]).buffer(5000); // 1984: Landsat 5 TM const col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size1984 = col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 data for 1984.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 2021: Landsat 8 const col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2021 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 9 data for 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate NDVI for 1984 const ndvi1984 = col1984.map(img => { const sr = img.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B4']); // Red, NIR for Landsat 5 const ndvi = sr.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']); return ndvi; }).mean(); const count1984 = ndvi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd').getInfo(); const mean1984 = ndvi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd').getInfo(); console.log(`1984 NDVI: ${mean1984 !== null ? mean1984.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${count1984}`); if (count1984 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 1984 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate NDVI for 2021 const ndvi2021 = col2021.map(img => { const sr = img.select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B5']); // Red, NIR for Landsat 8/9 const ndvi = sr.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']); return ndvi; }).mean(); const count2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd').getInfo(); const mean2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd').getInfo(); console.log(`2021 NDVI: ${mean2021 !== null ? mean2021.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${count2021}`); if (count2021 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2021 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Validation & Comparison if (mean1984 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean1984) || isNaN(mean2021)) { console.log('Calculation failed: null or NaN values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (mean1984 < -1 || mean1984 > 1 || mean2021 < -1 || mean2021 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI range detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: 1984 NDVI (${mean1984.toFixed(3)}) vs 2021 NDVI (${mean2021.toFixed(3)})`); if (mean1984 > mean2021) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
